_comment: Prototype copy of the AOS trust config. In the framework this is ~/.aos/config/trust.yaml (instance layer). See README.md for the field-by-field mapping.

_levels.0: shadow    - record what would have happened, allow nothing
_levels.1: approval  - every call blocks on a human
_levels.2: semi-auto - auto-allow, except always_escalate or destructive calls
